standard_prerequisites.name: Coherence and finiteness of higher direct images of a proper morphism

standard_prerequisites.name: The Leray spectral sequence
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the spectral sequence whose convergence gives the result.

core_obligations: Check that the formula is meaningful: the higher direct images R^i f_*G are coherent and only finitely many are nonzero, so that each chi(X, R^i f_*G) is defined (proof lines 6286-6290).
Invoke Leray: there is a spectral sequence E_2^{p,q} = H^p(X, R^q f_*G) converging to H^{p+q}(Y, G) (proof lines 6291-6295).

Use finiteness of cohomology on X to see that only finitely many E_2^{p,q} are nonzero and each is finite dimensional, hence the alternating sum of dimensions is independent of the page r (proof lines 6296-6303).

Conclude by convergence: for large r the terms equal E_infty, and convergence means H^n(Y, G) has a filtration with graded pieces E_infty^{p,q} for p + q = n, so the alternating sums of dimensions coincide (proof lines 6303-6307).
proof_roadmap: Verify coherence and finiteness of the higher direct images.
Write down the Leray spectral sequence.
Show the alternating sum of dimensions is page-independent.
Read the conclusion off the convergence filtration.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves chi(Y, G) = sum (-1)^i chi(X, R^i f_* G) for a morphism f : Y -> X of proper schemes over a field and a coherent G on Y. The proof first checks that the formula makes sense, using coherence and finiteness of the higher direct images, then applies the Leray spectral sequence with E_2^{p,q} = H^p(X, R^q f_* G) converging to H^{p+q}(Y, G) (proof lines 6286-6295). Finiteness of cohomology on X makes all E_2 terms finite dimensional and almost all zero, so the alternating sum of dimensions is independent of the page; since E_r stabilizes and convergence means a filtration on H^n(Y, G) with graded pieces E_infty^{p,q}, the alternating sums agree and the formula follows (proof lines 6296-6309). H2: the spectral-sequence bookkeeping through the alternating sum of dimensions is the substance and is a genuinely non-trivial assembly of cited machinery.
